questions.questionText: The average of 20 values is 45. Five values averaging 36 are removed and three values averaging 60 are added. Find the new average.

questions.questionText: Two groups have averages 48 and 60. Their combined average is 55.2. If the first group has 20 members, how many members are in the second group?
questions.explanationText: Let the second count be n. (20×48 + 60n) ÷ (20+n) = 55.2. Thus 960 + 60n = 1104 + 55.2n, so 4.8n = 144 and n = 30.

questions.questionText: The average of 30 scores is 72. The top 6 scores average 90 and the bottom 4 average 48. What is the average of the remaining 20 scores?

questions.questionText: A company has 40 employees averaging ₹50,000 and 60 employees averaging ₹40,000. Every employee in the first group receives a 10% raise; the second group receives a 5% raise. What is the new overall average salary?
questions.explanationText: New group averages are ₹55,000 and ₹42,000. Weighted total = 40×55,000 + 60×42,000 = ₹4,720,000. Divide by 100 to get ₹47,200.

questions.questionText: The average of 12 numbers is 30. One number is increased by 24 and another is decreased by 12. What is the new average?
questions.explanationText: Net increase in total = 24 − 12 = 12. Increase in average = 12÷12 = 1, so the new average is 31.

questions.questionText: A class average rises from 64 to 66 when 5 new students averaging 74 join. How many students were originally in the class?
questions.explanationText: Let the original count be n. 64n + 5×74 = 66(n+5). Thus 64n + 370 = 66n + 330, so 2n = 40 and n = 20.

questions.questionText: The average age of a group is 28 years. One person aged 42 leaves, and a person aged 24 joins; the average falls by 1 year. How many people are in the group?
questions.explanationText: The total falls by 42 − 24 = 18. A fall of 1 in the average with unchanged group size means the group contains 18 people.

questions.questionText: A fund is invested 25% at a return of 8%, 35% at 10%, and the rest at 12%. What is the weighted average return?
